established: The same scoped credential, host and USD-M endpoint retrieved the original opening order and both matching fills.
The unresolved close has a persisted exchange identity and a historical submit receipt reporting FILLED, but no recoverable order or fill evidence in the successful bounded reads.
The venue still reports a BRUSDT short residual of 256; an empty open-order list is not evidence that this position is flat.
Both protection lookup methods return TRIGGERING without an actual child order identity; no child fill or completed stop can be inferred.
Local quota denial is a separate observed operational issue; these successful direct reads still did not resolve the venue evidence conflict.
inferences: The positive opening control weighs against a wrong account, host, product or endpoint explanation for the absent close.
The sampled close age of approximately 36.4 hours does not meet the documented 3-day empty canceled/expired or 90-day general order cleanup thresholds.
The evidence is consistent with a demo-venue receipt/query/trade/position inconsistency, but does not identify the exchange-internal cause.
not_established: An exchange matching-engine defect, data reset, asynchronous persistence defect or any other specific internal cause.
The complete content of the historical submission response beyond its retained fields.
Successful BR close, final native-stop disposition, flat position, complete realized P&L or permission to resend an ambiguous order.
That support can provide missing demo order details; the official demo FAQ expressly limits this capability.

minimum_external_evidence_for_resolution: An authoritative same-account/product/symbol close record tied to both persisted identities, including final status, original/executed quantity and venue timestamps. If filled, complete trade identities, quantities, prices and commissions are required.
An authoritative final protection status and, if triggered, its actual child identity plus independently reconciled child order/trades. Absence alone is not cancellation.
Fresh complete position and outstanding-order observations, and complete attributable income/cash evidence over the settlement window before any final settlement claim.

If the venue cannot supply such evidence, keep the historical incident unresolved and retain the account/symbol admission block. Any migration/reset or new residual reduction requires a separately authorized, evidence-preserving workflow, not fabricated terminal statuses or P&L.

disposition.safe_next_step: Preserve unresolved identities and evidence; improve bounded polling and diagnostics without weakening order, position or settlement checks.
